featured.title: ClearDocs
featured.summary: Organisations upload student documents once, then check any file presented later against the stored original.
highlights: SHA-256 hash comparison flags any file that differs from the copy on record.
Kafka events move notification emails off the request path.
Verification audit log indexed in Elasticsearch for fast full-text search.

featured.title: Peer Vault
featured.summary: File storage and sharing split into independent Spring Boot services behind one gateway, with file content on IPFS.
highlights: Spring Cloud Gateway validates JWTs and routes to services found through Eureka.
Files are stored on IPFS and served by content hash.
Registration and file-share events flow through Kafka to a notification service.

featured.title: Form Fusion
featured.summary: Create forms, share them by link, collect responses and review them per form.
highlights: Email OTP verification at sign-up, then JWT-secured access.
REST APIs nested by owner and form: users own forms, forms own questions.
React + Redux frontend backed by Spring Boot and MySQL.
